description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY.md §3.3: inspect the new DSN's dsns_auth table directly (as admin) to confirm CreateDSNHandler seeded a self-grant for the creator. This is checked structurally rather than by having dsncreatortest try to access the DSN, because that functional path is now confounded by §3.4's separate identity-level ego.dsn.admin bypass (already fixed in this branch) -- dsncreatortest holds that identity permission to be able to create DSNs at all, so it alone would let them read/write this DSN whether or not the per-DSN self-grant this test is actually about exists.
